info.title: Pledge
info.description: A 42-second video pledge, kept on the pledger's own site. The browser records the take and puts it in the page's assets through the Farm plugin's upload; seal turns it into pledge.mp4, pledge.m4a and poster.jpg with ffmpeg on this farm (inside the pledge-seal scope on a Pi), hashes each, deletes the take and writes pledge.json, the pledge record. Signing comes later (Video Pledge Plan, Phase 3): the record leaves signatures empty.

get.summary: Who pledges here: this site, its owner and its fish

200.description: site, owner {name, id}, fish {src, sha256} or null, seconds (42) and the kinds a pledge may be.

post.summary: Seal a recorded take into a pledge
post.description: Reads assets/<slug>/<take>, writes pledge.mp4 (H.264 + AAC, at most 42 s, metadata stripped, faststart; streams copied when the take is already H.264 and AAC), pledge.m4a and poster.jpg beside it, deletes the take and writes pledge.json, which is also the answer. One seal at a time per farm.

slug.description: The pledge page's slug; its asset folder holds the take.

take.description: The take's file name in that folder: take.mp4 or take.webm.

title.description: The pledge page's title, Pledge of <Name> <date>.

name.description: The pledger's name as they gave it; the site owner's name when empty.

amount.description: What is pledged, in words: 42 hours.

recorded_at.description: When the take was kept, ISO 8601.

duration.description: The take's length as the browser measured it, seconds.

200.description: pledge.json version 1: pledger {name, id, fish, site}, slug, recorded_at, duration, kind, amount, files {pledge.mp4, pledge.m4a, poster.jpg: src, bytes, sha256}, seal {seconds, encoder, cap}, words null, signatures [].

409.description: That folder already holds a sealed pledge.
